weather.blurb: Hot, but normal for us. The evening walk is the good one.

air.blurb: Fine for most of us. If your lungs are touchy, take it a little easy.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 4 · Grass 3 · Weed 4 · Elm, Ragweed, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Elm and ragweed and grasses are heavy today. Windows closed, meds early.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 80,900 megawatts, with 106,800 on hand.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 12 hours and 2 minutes today, and down by 7:23 p.m.
